# `src/generated/` — generated code, do not edit

The type files in this directory are generated by
[`openapi-typescript`](https://openapi-ts.dev) from the vendored OpenAPI specs at the repo
root. Do not hand-edit either of them. This README is the one hand-written exception that
lives in the directory — edit it directly when the process below changes.

| File | Regenerated by | From |
|---|---|---|
| `api-types.ts` | `npm run generate:types` | `dws-api-spec.yml` |
| `extract-types.ts` | `npm run generate:types:extract` | `dws-data-extraction-spec.yml` |

Hand-edits to either generated file are overwritten the next time someone regenerates.
CI also runs both generate commands with `--check` on every PR and fails if the working
tree would change — see the repo-root `AGENTS.md` for exactly what that CI failure does
and does not enforce today.

**To change an API type, don't edit these files.** Update the spec (or pull a newer one
from upstream), re-run the relevant `generate:types*` script, and commit the result. If
the generated shape still looks wrong, fix the spec or the codegen flags in
`package.json` — see the "codegen flags are load-bearing" section in the repo-root
`AGENTS.md` before touching those flags.

If the spec truly cannot express the shape you need, hand-written types belong in
`src/types/http.ts`, not here — see `AGENTS.md` for the bar and a worked example.
